chapter_title: MINDFUL EATING A PATH TO A HEALTHY BODY

items.title: What Do We Eat?
items.explanation: Everyone eats food every day, and it is an essential part of daily life. Food should be wholesome, consumed in moderate quantities, and appropriate for the season, time, and place.

items.title: Food in Different Regions
items.explanation: Different parts of India have different traditional foods and crops grown locally. For example, Punjab traditionally eats Makki di roti, sarson da ghat, and pulses, while Karnataka eats Idli, dosa, and coconut chutney.
